europe_now.title: Investigation Launched into Black Sea Tanker Fire off Romania
europe_now.summary: Romanian authorities are investigating a suspected drone strike after a tanker caught fire off the country's Black Sea coast. Search teams are conducting operations to locate eight crew members who remain missing.

sources.headline: Eight crew missing in tanker fire off Romania's coast

top_stories.title: EU Summit Focuses on Budget Battles and Strategic Challenges
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders are convening for contentious negotiations over the bloc's budget ahead of looming elections. The summit agenda also features high-level discussions addressing relations with China and continued assistance for Ukraine.

sources.headline: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
EU leaders head into high-stakes budget battle as elections loom

top_stories.title: Concerns Rise Over Ukrainian Military Connectivity and Drone Speeds
top_stories.summary: New operating limits have exposed Ukraine's reliance on Starlink communications infrastructure during combat operations against Russia. Elon Musk claimed that the United States government might be behind performance slowdowns affecting Ukrainian drones.

sources.headline: Restrictions expose Ukraine's Starlink dependency in Russia war
Musk says US government may be behind slowdown of Ukraine drone speeds

top_stories.title: Croatia Objects to Montenegro's European Union Accession Bid
top_stories.summary: Croatia has intervened to slow progress on Montenegro's pathway toward European Union membership. The move introduces a diplomatic roadblock for the candidate country's accession negotiations with the European bloc.

sources.headline: Croatia pumps the brakes on Montenegro’s EU membership bid

top_stories.title: Tanker Blaze and Missing Crew Spark Black Sea Security Inquiry
top_stories.summary: Maritime authorities in Romania have opened an inquiry into a potential drone attack on a vessel off its coastline. Rescue teams continue searching for eight missing mariners following the fire aboard the tanker.

sources.headline: Eight crew missing in tanker fire off Romania's coast
